Closes #100

## Summary

Provide the Bounty #12 Docker Compose monitoring example: Chronicle, Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana, and a sample metric emitter. The existing contribution and claim are unchanged.

The stack includes a container entry point that forwards Chronicle's loopback HTTP API onto the Compose network and exports Prometheus-format availability and metric-name-count gauges. Host ports bind to loopback. The emitter uses the required request headers without disabling Chronicle's CSRF validation. Named volumes retain the database and monitoring data. Grafana receives a provisioned datasource and dashboard; maintained alert rules reach a local Alertmanager receiver. External notification delivery requires a configured receiver.

## Run

```bash
cd examples/docker-compose-monitoring
docker compose up --build -d
docker compose ps
curl -f http://localhost:8086/health
curl -f http://localhost:8086/metrics
```

The example README contains configuration, shutdown, and retained-volume instructions.

## Executed acceptance

The maintained runtime source at `a991190eef51d555c1bcaa4dacc960256797120e` was built and run with Docker Compose v2.38.2 on hosted Linux. [Run 37189161693](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/chronicle/actions/runs/37189161693) completed the real stack acceptance with all 19 HTTP/state checks passing; Prometheus and Alertmanager configuration checks also passed.

Observed behavior includes service readiness, actual line-protocol ingestion, a nonzero scraped metric count, provisioned Grafana datasource/dashboard and a successful datasource-proxy query. Stopping Chronicle made its Prometheus target go down, caused the maintained alert to fire, and delivered the alert to Alertmanager. A uniquely named timestamp/value/tag remained identical after stopping both the emitter and Chronicle and restarting only Chronicle; the target then recovered.

The [maintained evidence section](https://github.com/woahwhattheheck/chronicle/blob/be2161b3486d2ab94bc8feb019d0ad41e200ab44/examples/docker-compose-monitoring/README.md#executed-acceptance-evidence--october-4-2026) records the source and workflow pins, earlier failure/repair history, exact persistence point, image/runtime provenance, and artifact digest. The later documentation and reusable-workflow corrections are not presented as a new runtime execution.

These results establish the maintained local containers and APIs, Grafana provisioning/query behavior, and local Alertmanager receipt. They do not establish external notifications, browser rendering, other-platform support, upstream CI approval, maintainer acceptance, or bounty payment.
